bibl.title: P. OXY. XXXV 2737 and Alcman's ancient reception.
bibl.seg: Vasiliki Kousoulini, P. OXY. XXXV 2737 and Alcman's ancient reception.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XXXV, 2737 (= MP3 157.1; LDAB 345) provides indications that Alcman's name was, possibly, involved in the poetic rivalry between Aristophanes and his fellow-comedians, and that Aristophanes and his audience were both aware of Alcman's compositions.
